store_config_node: store a config node into the Hydra ConfigStore singleton repository with a name, group, and provider
load_config_node: load a deep-copied ConfigNode from the ConfigStore by its config path string
list_config_group: list all config names in a ConfigStore group at the given path
get_config_type: get the ObjectType of a ConfigStore path to check if it is a group, config, or not found
store_config_with_provider: use ConfigStoreWithProvider as a context manager to store configs attributed to a named provider
